title: Functions [String]
description:
## String Functions
SQL has built-in functions to manipulate text:

- `UPPER(text)` - converts to uppercase
- `LOWER(text)` - converts to lowercase
- `LENGTH(text)` - returns character count
- `SUBSTR(text, start, length)` - extracts part of a string
- `REPLACE(text, old, new)` - replaces text
- `TRIM(text)` - removes leading/trailing spaces

```sql
SELECT UPPER('hello');        -- HELLO
SELECT LENGTH('hello');       -- 5
SELECT SUBSTR('hello', 2, 3); -- ell
SELECT REPLACE('hello', 'l', 'r'); -- herro
```
